    enum 
    ExplorationVerdict
    The verdict returned by VirtualCallResolver.tryAdvanceCall(SootMethod, MethodSignature, InvokableStmt) to control call graph expansion: ExplorationVerdict.EXPLORE_METHOD admits the edge and expands the callee, ExplorationVerdict.STOP_AFTER_CALL admits the edge but does not expand the callee via this edge, and ExplorationVerdict.STOP drops the edge entirely.
